description: What's happening on the islands and across Charleston, as one list cut on the islands' clock: the Towns' and the library's calendars, the music venues' own feeds (the Charleston Pour House, the Royal American), the year's big dates, the special events, what venues posted and a person approved, and a weekly sweep of the venues with no feed. Every item carries its organizer's page; the door price is as the venue lists it. Use when = today, tomorrow, weekend, week (next 7 days) or all (next 3 weeks); tag = Music for live music.

island.description: islands = Kiawah, Seabrook, Johns Island, Wadmalaw; charleston = the rest of Charleston
